4.en: The two products are counterparts, but one is made for children.
4.zh: 这两种产品相对应，不过其中一种是为儿童设计的。

6.en: Show your student card to get a discount on the ticket.
6.zh: 出示学生证即可享受票价折扣。

10.en: Please keep the receipt in case you need to dispute the bill.
10.zh: 请保留收据，以备你需要对账单提出异议。

12.en: The family paid off its debt over five years.
12.zh: 这家人用了五年还清债务。

22.en: She grasped the main idea after the teacher gave an example.
22.zh: 老师举例后，她理解了主要意思。

29.en: The building will undergo repairs next month.
29.zh: 这栋楼下个月将进行维修。

32.en: These shoes are durable enough for daily walks.
32.zh: 这双鞋足够耐穿，适合每天走路。

33.en: The meeting lasted for the duration of the lunch break.
33.zh: 会议持续了整个午休时间。

38.en: From the empty seats, we can infer that few people came.
38.zh: 从空座位可以推断来的人很少。

40.en: Safety is our main concern when children use the pool.
40.zh: 孩子们使用泳池时，安全是我们最关心的事。

44.en: He stayed indifferent to the rude comments online.
44.zh: 他对网上的无礼评论不为所动。

52.en: Too many late nights can undermine your health.
52.zh: 熬夜太多会逐渐损害健康。

54.en: The paint began to deteriorate after years in the sun.
54.zh: 经过多年日晒，油漆开始老化。
